evidence.text: The fictional planning policy uses expected weekly enrollment multiplied by kits per participant as baseline weekly demand. Lead-time demand is weekly demand times lead-time days divided by 7. The reorder point includes an additional 14 days of safety coverage. A shortfall inside lead time requires escalation.

On-hand inventory is assumed to share one expiry date in this demonstration. If expiry is inside the replenishment lead time, escalate for review even when quantity appears sufficient. Confirm lot-specific usable quantities, quarantine status and expiry in the source inventory system.

A planner reviews enrollment changes, kit usage assumptions, shipping capacity and authorized site allocations before approving a replenishment order. The suggested reorder quantity is a planning aid; this service neither allocates participant treatment nor creates an order.
